_comment: Copy to config.json, or select another path with ARTEX_CONFIG. Only database and skill_dir belong here. Configure model providers through environment variables or the app.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. ARTEX_PG_DSN takes precedence. Use individual fields below or a complete database.dsn.
_comment_database_dsn: Alternative: replace database with the complete DSN below. A nonempty dsn overrides individual fields.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory. Each child directory contains a SKILL.md. Priority: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR, this field, then skills/ beside the executable. Relative paths use the current working directory.
